title: Degraded network operational acceptance and test harness for private/VPC deployments
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Purpose: Define minimal operational requirements and a repeatable test harness to validate Redwood Private (VPC/on-prem) behavior when customer networks experience asymmetric or degraded egress (partial mirror, blocked hosts, intermittent DNS, bandwidth throttling). Focus is upgrades, bootstrap, and runtime fallback behaviors without requiring full egress availability. This ticket scopes acceptance criteria, deterministic test scenarios, and runbook hooks for on-call escalation.
goals: Provide clear pass/fail acceptance criteria for deploying and upgrading Private control plane under constrained egress
Ship a small automated harness (k8s job + synthetic network shaper) to run deterministic degrade scenarios in CI/nightly
Define required telemetry signals and operator health indicators for graceful degradation and rollback
Document operator runbook and minimal customer network allowlist for safe recovery
out_of_scope: Full offline/air-gap media delivery workflows (handled by separate PMs)
Operator rewrite or major architecture changes to bootstrap flow
Large-scale multi-region disaster recovery and DR failover exercises
requirements: Minimal egress allowlist: list of FQDNs and IPs needed for a successful bootstrap when using staged mirror fallback
Upgrade validation mode: operator must be able to run a dry-run that verifies image provenance, signature checks, and local artifact parity within the VPC without contacting external registries
Canary health gating: control-plane upgrade canary must verify KMS rotation, secret rehydration, and node-agent connectivity over limited egress windows
Telemetry surface: operator exports metrics for artifact-sync-status, mirror-fallback-engaged, last-successful-bootstrap, and degraded-network-retry-count
Graceful fallback policy: when primary egress is absent, system must automatically switch to configured private mirror and surface an actionable alert within 2 minutes
Retry/backoff invariants: artifact transfers must use exponential backoff with jitter and fail cleanly (no partial artifacts) before triggering rollback
Runtime SLO behavior: inference requests routed to Private nodes during degraded network must return 5xx < 1% and maintain 95th percentile latency target within 1.5x baseline for at least 30 minutes
Operator health checks: admin console shows explicit state for 'mirror-provisioned' and 'egress-partial', with links to logs and remediation steps
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: Fresh VPC bootstrap succeeds using only the documented minimal allowlist and a staged mirror provided in test environment
AC-2: Upgrade canary performs dry-run validation and stalls upgrade if signature mismatch or artifact checksum divergence is detected
AC-3: When primary egress is blocked in the test harness, system engages mirror within 120s and records a mirror-fallback metric that is queryable in Console
AC-4: Artifact transfers in degraded mode never leave partial artifacts on disk; failures are atomic and retried per policy
AC-5: Synthetic inference traffic under degraded egress (local models) shows <1% error rate and 95th percentile latency <= 1.5x baseline for 30-minute window in nightly run
AC-6: Console exposes a single remediation workflow link that initiates operator rollback and notifies on-call with runbook snippet
AC-7: Nightly CI harness runs three deterministic network degrade scenarios (egress block, DNS failures, bandwidth cap) and publishes pass/fail results to the internal dashboard
test_plan: Create k8s test cluster with Istio sidecars disabled to avoid network masking
Deploy Private operator and control plane using mirror registry endpoints only; validate bootstrap success
Scenario A: full egress block to upstream; assert mirror-fallback engages and artifact sync completes
Scenario B: DNS resolution fails for external registries but IP allowlist present; assert dry-run upgrade validation rejects unsigned images
Scenario C: bandwidth throttling to 1Mbps for 15 minutes during canary upgrade; assert artifact transfer backpressure and eventual rollback if transfer time exceeds threshold
Collect metrics and traces; validate Console shows mirror-fallback metric and exposes remediation link
Automate harness as k8s CronJob and surface results in nightly pipeline dashboard with logs attached
dependencies: ENG-30512 (console: mirror-fallback metric and remediation CTA)
notes: This ticket intentionally narrows scope to operator-level acceptance and small harness; larger airgap media flows remain in PM-77142 and PM-512379
Coordinate with Security for KMS handling in test harness; do not embed production keys
Use synthetic images and test KMS keys for CI runs; preserve reproducibility between runs
